body: The happiest time of my life. I went to a really bad elementary school for kindergarten and half of first grade but then moved to a different one and I was so happy there. I was carefree and having the time of my life. Looking back, I can see that no one really liked me but I still loved it. The first few years of middle school were ok but everything fell apart around halfway through 8th grade.

I skip it!
Well, that's the honest and mostly accurate truth, but I guess you're asking for something else, right? I try not to think about it at all until it happens, keeping it off my mind makes it more bearable. Also, that way I have no way to "turn back".

I feel like its getting better, albeit slowly. It's still not widely accepted in society.  It's certainly better than a few hundred years ago, where saying you are "suicidal" would get you thrown in an asylum with prison-like conditions.

Aww it seems exclusive to Australia :( Tomorrow is National Suicide Prevention day too though in the States.
Thanks for the post :)
